faqs.question: What does a complete brand identity package include?
faqs.answer: A full identity package includes primary and secondary logo marks, comprehensive brand guidelines, color system, custom typography pairings, stationery kit, social media templates, and all production-ready vector source files (AI, EPS, SVG, print-ready PDF, PNG).

faqs.question: Can you refresh or modernize an existing brand logo?
faqs.answer: Yes! I conduct thorough brand audits to refine, simplify, and modernize existing logos, enhancing digital scalability while preserving established brand recognition and heritage.

faqs.question: Do you provide print-ready dielines for packaging?
faqs.answer: Yes! I deliver 100% factory-ready dieline files in CMYK with precise bleed margins, crease/cut lines, spot UV layers, emboss/deboss zones, and foil stamp specifications compatible with domestic and international print vendors.

faqs.question: Do you specialize in food supplement and health packaging?
faqs.answer: Yes, tactical food supplement, organic healthcare, wellness syrups, and herbal medicine packaging are core specializations, backed by regulatory-compliant typography, ingredient hierarchy, and high-converting 3D visuals.

faqs.question: Do you provide 3D product renders optimized for Amazon, Shopify, and e-commerce?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every packaging project includes photorealistic 3D product renders and lifestyle mockups optimized for Amazon, Shopify, e-commerce listings, and high-converting social media ads.

faqs.question: Can you create motion graphics and social video ads?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! I produce dynamic 2D motion graphics, kinetic typography, promotional video ads, vertical Instagram/Facebook Reels, and animated logo reveals using Adobe After Effects.

faqs.question: What is your step-by-step design workflow?
faqs.answer: My workflow follows 5 structured steps: 1. Discovery & Project Brief, 2. Market Research & Moodboard, 3. Concept Generation & 3D Mockups, 4. Iterative Client Revisions, and 5. Final Asset Delivery.

faqs.question: What is your typical project delivery timeline?
faqs.answer: Initial concepts are typically presented within 3 to 5 business days. Full brand identity systems take 5–10 days, while packaging labels or promo videos take approximately 3–6 days depending on project scope.

faqs.question: What is your revision and satisfaction policy?
faqs.answer: I provide iterative, collaborative design revisions within the agreed project scope during active milestones to guarantee you are completely satisfied with every visual asset before final file sign-off.

faqs.question: What information is needed to start a new design project?
faqs.answer: To start smoothly, I need a brief overview of your brand goals, target audience, preferred visual styles, required deliverables/dimensions, and any existing logos or copy. You can submit these directly via our Project Brief form.

faqs.question: How do you calculate pricing for a project?
faqs.answer: I work on transparent, custom project-based pricing tailored specifically to your deliverables, scope, and timeline—no rigid hourly fees. Reach out with a short project brief for an exact quotation.

faqs.question: What payment methods and terms do you accept?
faqs.answer: I accept Bank Wire Transfer, Wise (international), and local mobile banking (bKash/Nagad in Bangladesh). Typical terms are 50% upfront deposit and 50% upon final approval before delivery.

faqs.question: Can you sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before we share our project brief?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. I respect intellectual property and trade confidentiality. I am always happy to review and sign a mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before you share proprietary product details or project briefs.

faqs.question: Will I own full commercial rights and receive vector source files?
faqs.answer: Yes! Upon final payment clearance, you receive 100% full commercial copyright ownership. You will get complete editable vector source files (AI, EPS, SVG) along with high-res PNG, JPG, and print-ready PDFs.

faqs.question: What is your professional background, current role, and experience?
faqs.answer: I am a Senior Visualizer with 7+ years of professional design experience (6+ years in senior leadership). Currently, I lead brand identity and packaging visual direction at Go Nature BD, having previously spent over 3 years leading design teams at Chaldal Ltd.

faqs.question: What creative design software and tools do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: I specialize in industry-standard software including Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Canva, CapCut, and modern AI-assisted visual production workflows for rapid concept visualization.

faqs.question: Where are you located and what is your remote work availability?
faqs.answer: I am based in Jashore, Bangladesh (UTC+6) and actively available for OnSite, Remote, and Hybrid collaborations globally. Standard inquiry response time is under 1 hour during active business hours.

faqs.question: Where can I explore your verified design portfolio and case studies?
faqs.answer: You can explore complete visual identity case studies, packaging dielines, and motion projects on my verified Behance portfolio. Feel free to use the Behance button in this chat to browse directly.
